title: Thai Crispy Phyllo Bites
description: Crunchy and savory bites filled with a flavorful Thai-inspired filling, perfect as an appetizer or snack.

ingredients.name: mustardy
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp, mixed with 1 tbsp olive oil
ingredients.notes: can use store-bought mustards for convenience

instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together mediterranean, mustardy, and crumbly.
Place a small spoonful of the mediterranean mixture onto the center of each phyllo square.
Fold the phyllo squares into triangles or other desired shapes, pressing edges to seal.
Brush the tops with olive oil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
